6027.title: Workflow task parentage misclassifies launcher rows
6027.rootCauseOneLine: Semantic projection interprets a local workflow task parent link as delegation evidence, nesting the workflow beneath its launcher.
6027.proposedFix: Place pure local-workflow task children beside their tool launcher in projection, preserving stored parent links and containing delegations.
6027.caveats: Deterministic source/renderer reproduction, not a new native Claude or iOS session; existing pagination suites are not an exhaustive workflow-specific walk.
